author: Chase Davis
title: Bobby Witt Jr. swipes a bag but goes hitless in 5-2 loss
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. went 0-for-4 in loss to the Rays with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: After Thursday's loss to Tampa Bay, Witt is batting .290 with 12 home runs, 36 RBI, 44 runs scored and 29 stolen bases through 82 games. He's second in the league in steals behind only Nasim Nunez, and second in fWAR behind only Pete Crow-Armstrong.

author: Chase Davis
title: Carter Jensen goes yard, but Royals fall short vs. Rays
desc: Carter Jensen went 2-for-4 in loss to the Rays with a home run, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Thursday's loss to Tampa Bay, Jensen is slashing .251/.314/.452 with 13 home runs, 47 RBI, 41 runs scored and a .330 wOBA across 81 games. He went deep twice in the three-game series against the Rays and now has three homers against them on the season.

author: Chase Davis
title: Isaac Collins goes deep as Royals fall to Rays
desc: Isaac Collins went 1-for-3 in Thursday's loss to the Rays with a solo home run, one run scored, one RBI and one strikeout.
impact: After Thursday's loss to Tampa Bay, Collins is batting .232 with four home runs, 25 RBI, 31 runs scored and four stolen bases across 77 games. He sits against lefties every so often, but doesn't do enough consistently to matter for fantasy lineups.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kolek shelled early as Royals fall to Rays
desc: Stephen Kolek allowed three earned runs on four hits and one walk while striking out zero over two innings in Thursday's loss to the Rays.
impact: After the outing, Kolek now sports a 4.50 ERA and 1.24 WHIP with a 4-3 record through 10 starts. He was pitching on 10 days' rest and showed signs of rust. He only allowed one hard hit, but labored through his two innings with 51 pitches. He'll face the Mets on the road next time through the rotation.

author: Chase Davis
title: Tommy Edman stays hot with two hits and a swipe in win
desc: Tommy Edman went 2-for-4 in a win over the Padres with a double, two runs scored, one RBI, one stolen base and one walk.
impact: After Thursday's win over San Diego, Edman is batting .378 with one home run, nine RBI, five runs scored and one stolen base across 13 games. He's been scorching hot at the plate since his return from the IL. This was his first steal attempt since June 2, 2025. It would be a big development if he got back to being a stolen base contributor.

author: Chase Davis
title: Dalton Rushing torches Padres for four-hit, four-RBI night
desc: Dalton Rushing went 4-for-4 in Thursday's 12-7 win over the Padres with a home run, a double, three runs scored and four RBI.
impact: Through 53 games, Rushing is batting .263 with 10 home runs, 29 RBI, 27 runs scored, and a .365 wOBA. Will Smith is expected to be out until after the All-Star break, so Rushing should see plenty of run.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Tucker racks up four hits as Dodgers outslug Padres 12-7
desc: Kyle Tucker went 4-for-4 in a win over the Padres with a double, three runs scored, one RBI and a walk.
impact: After Thursday's win over San Diego, Tucker is batting .249 with seven home runs, six stolen bases, 50 runs scored and 45 RBI across 82 games. This was his first four-hit game in more than a year (06/28/2025). Over his last six games, he's picked up 10 hits, six runs and five RBI.

author: Chase Davis
title: Will Klein cruises through two scoreless frames in 12-7 win
desc: Will Klein struck out three while allowing one hit and no walks over two scoreless innings in Thursday's 12-7 win over San Diego.
impact: After Thursday's outing, Klein owns a 2.36 ERA and 1.37 WHIP with a 10.2 K/9, one save, and 11 holds across 29 appearances. He entered the game in the fourth with the Dodgers down 6-4. He held the Padres scoreless as his offense rattled off six more runs in his two innings. Klein has been used in many different situations and has been valuable for the Dodgers.

author: Chase Davis
title: Roki Sasaki survives early blowup as Dodgers' bats bail him out
desc: Roki Sasaki allowed six earned runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out three over three innings in Thursday's win over the Padres.
impact: After the win, Sasaki now has a 5.40 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with a 3-5 record through 15 starts. This marks his shortest outing of the year, and the three homers tie a season high. He's impossible to trust even against the Rockies in Los Angeles next time out.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Walker (back) returns to lineup Friday
desc: Christian Walker is back in the Astros lineup on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Walker left Wednesday's game against the Twins with lower-back stiffness. He is back at first base and batting cleanup on Friday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Masyn Winn racks up three hits in win over Braves
desc: Masyn Winn went 3-for-4 in Thursday's 11-5 win over Atlanta with one run scored, one RBI and a walk.
impact: Through 76 games, Winn's batting .249 with three homers, 33 RBI, 36 runs scored, and seven steals, with a .297 wOBA. It was just his third three-hit performance of the season as he nears his batting average closer to .250. He just doesn't do enough for fantasy.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremiah Jackson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Orioles recalled Jeremiah Jackson from Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Jackson returns to a depth role off the bench for Baltimore.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chadwick Tromp designated for assignment
desc: The Orioles designated Chadwick Tromp for assignment.
impact: Tromp loses his spot on the Orioles 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Nunez recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Orioles recalled Anthony Nunez from Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Nunez will hold a middle-relief role for Baltimore with Ryan Helsley placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Orioles placed Ryan Helsley on the 15-day injured list with right elbow discomfort.
impact: Helsley will be sidelined through the All-Star break. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.
